lead: A `-p nvs-server` test can drive a real upgrade handshake, and one connection carries the upgradable request and an ordinary one after it.
body: `hyper` keeps a connection whose `Connection: Upgrade` request was answered `200`: the response is framed normally and keep-alive continues. `only_an_upgradable_request_is_offered_a_slot` is the shape, and `request.extensions().get::<hyper::upgrade::OnUpgrade>()` answers "can this connection be upgraded".
